Programs Overview
Certificate Programs
Business for Bioscientists
The Business for Bioscientists Certificate is designed to provide you with a fundamental background in business to enhance employment opportunities and success.
Health Professions Teaching and Technology
This certificate provides health professions educators with a foundation in health science education, teaching skills, and the science of teaching.
Applied Health Informatics
This certificate prepares healthcare professionals with the skills necessary to effectively apply health informatics in practice to improve patient care.
Heathcare Quality Improvement
Through this certificate, health care professionals will engage in the application and utility of quality improvement to optimize healthcare service delivery.

Our workshops, presentations and seminars bolster you with an extra edge for present and future professional ventures, regardless of the career you choose.

Badge Programs
Service-Learning and Professional Development Badge Program
A program that empowers graduate students to document their learning from time devoted to a wide range of activities, many of which occur outside of the laboratory or classroom, that supplement their education, support professional development, and enhance career preparation.
Transferable Skills Digital Badge Program
Online microcredentials not for academic credit that allow you to showcase your achievements and skills gained through co-curricular learning experiences. Digital badges can be displayed on social media platforms. Time spent earning these digital badges is automatically applied to the Service Learning and Professional Development Badge Program.

Testing Requirements
UNMC graduate courses are advanced and require a firm understanding of the English language in order to best succeed. That's why we require all students whose first language is not English to take a proficiency test.
The tests you can take to show English language proficiency are listed below, together with minimum score requirements. Some programs may have higher minimum score requirements. We require the official score reports, not photocopies of the scores. We will not accept scores that are more than two years old. We do not accept TOEFL BEST score reporting.
TOEFL OLD iBT
Minimum score = 85
TOEFL NEW iBT
Minimum band score = 4.5
IELTS (academic test)
Minimum band score of 6.5
Duolingo
Minimum score = 120
Please Note- Applicants to the IGPBS Graduate Program should meet the minimum scores listed below:
TOEFL OLD iBT
Minimum score = 95 (minimum score 20 in each category)
TOEFL NEW iBT
Minimum score = 5.0
IELTS (academic test)
Minimum score = 7.0
Duolingo
Minimum score = 130
Submitting your official TOEFL scores to UNMC
For more information on how to submit your official TOEFL scores to UNMC, please refer to these instructions.
TOEFL and IELTS scores are sent to UNMC electronically. The ETS Institution Code for UNMC is 6896.
Duolingo Test Access Information
Information on Preparing for the exam
Take the exam or practice exam
Request a Duolingo Access Code
A few days after taking the exam, you will receive the certified test results. You will need to log on to your account and click on the "send results" button next to your test results. Finally, select the University of Nebraska Medical Center Graduate Studies to have your results sent to us. For additional information, please review the Frequently Asked Questions.
Exemptions
You may be exempt from the English proficiency requirement if you have been studying at a university inside the U.S. for at least one academic year or attending a university in a country where the only official language is English, such as U.K., Australia or Canada (excluding Quebec).
To request an exemption from the English proficiency requirement, please fill out this online form. Graduate Studies will contact you after completion to let you know if you are eligible for an exemption.
Evaluation for a waiver of the English language proficiency exam is not determined by the prevalence of spoken English in a country or the language of instruction at a university.
Important: Your application must include enough academic and institutional details (such as your degree information, dates of attendance, and university location) for Graduate Studies to verify your eligibility. Incomplete or missing information may delay or prevent review of your exemption request.
